mapper.select: SELECT state_json FROM procurement_payment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{requestId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND employee_id=#{employeeId} AND version=#{requestVersion}
mapper.update: UPDATE procurement_payment_check_job SET version=#{version},status=#{status},state_json=#{stateJson},active_request_id=#{requestId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND input_json=#{inputJson} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM procurement_payment_check_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no),0) FROM procurement_payment_check_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT id FROM procurement_payment_check_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{requestId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM procurement_payment_check_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_request_id=#{requestId}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,NULL AS process_instance_id FROM procurement_payment_check_job q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
